scope: independent recomputation from existing native actual h/eta and field outputs; no integration or production oracle imports

actual.model:
HydrostaticFreeSurfaceModel{CUDAGPU, RectilinearGrid}(time = 0 seconds, iteration = 0)
├── grid: 8×32×16 RectilinearGrid{Float64, Periodic, Bounded, Bounded} on CUDAGPU with 3×3×3 halo
├── timestepper: SplitRungeKuttaTimeStepper
├── tracers: (T, S, physical_T, physical_S)
├── closure: Nothing
├── buoyancy: SeawaterBuoyancy with g=9.81 and LinearEquationOfState(thermal_expansion=0.0002, haline_contraction=0.00076) with ĝ = NegativeZDirection()
├── free surface: SplitExplicitFreeSurface with gravitational acceleration 9.81 m s⁻²
│   └── substepping: FixedSubstepNumber(5)
├── advection scheme: 
│   ├── momentum: VectorInvariant
│   ├── T: WENO{3, Float64, Oceananigans.Utils.BackendOptimizedDivision}(order=5)
│   ├── S: WENO{3, Float64, Oceananigans.Utils.BackendOptimizedDivision}(order=5)
│   ├── physical_T: WENO{3, Float64, Oceananigans.Utils.BackendOptimizedDivision}(order=5)
│   └── physical_S: WENO{3, Float64, Oceananigans.Utils.BackendOptimizedDivision}(order=5)
├── vertical_coordinate: ZStarCoordinate
└── coriolis: FPlane{Oceananigans.Advection.EnstrophyConserving{Float64}, Float64}
actual.thermodynamic_variables: native linear-EOS anomalies plus two advected physical witnesses
